objective:
Add a module `demo_app/html_report.py` with two public functions that render version infos as an HTML page. `escape_html(text: str) -> str` replaces exactly these five characters and nothing else: `&` with `&`, `<` with `<`, `>` with `>`, `"` (double quote) with `"`, and `'` (single quote) with `'`. Each character of the input is replaced once (so `<` becomes `<`, never double-escaped). All other characters, including non-ASCII characters, newlines and spaces, are left unchanged. `render_html(infos: list[dict]) -> str` returns a complete HTML5 page as one string. `infos` is a list of dicts as printed by `amplai ops version`; only the keys `package_version` and `stage` are used, other keys are ignored. The page is exactly the following, with the lines separated by a single newline character (`\n`), the whole text ending with a newline after ``, and no other whitespace anywhere: AMPLAI versions [one row line per info, see below]
versionstage
The row lines replace the `[one row line per info]` placeholder line: for each info, in input order, the line `VS` followed by a newline, where `V` is `escape_html(info["package_version"])` and `S` is `escape_html(info["stage"])`. An empty `infos` list gives the page with no row lines at all (`\n` is directly followed by `\n`). A missing `stage` key gives an empty cell (``); an empty string in either field also gives an empty cell. A `package_version` that is missing or is not a `str` raises `ValueError`; a `stage` that is present but not a `str` (including `None`) also raises `ValueError`. Invalid input raises before any page is returned, wherever in the list the bad entry is. The input list and its dicts are not modified.
acceptance: escape_html replaces & < > " ' with & < > " ' in one pass (no double escaping of the produced entities) and leaves every other character unchanged

render_html([]) returns exactly ' AMPLAI versions
versionstage
